note: Archive register for Housing Domain 10. Records only: catalogue pages were read, and no images or files were downloaded. image_url points to the holder's own image link and is recorded, not reproduced. can_reproduce is true only for public domain, OGL or CC-BY; the IWM Non-Commercial Licence is false for this project. Discovery record pages returned a bot check to automated fetches, so TNA, Parliamentary Archives and London Archives records were read from Discovery's public records API for the same ids, and rights are recorded as unknown. pending_event_ids name Acts not yet in events.json; move them to linked_event_ids once those events exist. Historic England Archive items were not added because its pages blocked automated reading.
